intent.message: The export defect needs an audit before its severity and fix scope are known, while the fix itself takes two periods and core delivery has six periods remaining. Given my current stress, I need priorities and capacity clarified before taking on overlapping commitments.

I need the demonstration to succeed, but the extra feature was promised before technical capacity was confirmed. Please confirm whether a reduced scope is feasible so I can align expectations with management.

note: Small smoke evaluation; not a general quality benchmark. Costs estimated from reported usage, not billing invoices.

actions.description: Deliver the agreed scope after the required checks.
